POLICY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
POLICY.DATA_BODY: We store what you give us to play: your email address, username and avatar, a hash of your password (never the password itself), your two-factor secret in encrypted form, your friendships, the messages you send, your matches and your rating.
POLICY.PURPOSE_BODY: Your data is used only to run the game: to log you in, match you with opponents, keep your history and let you chat with your friends. Your email address is used to verify your account, send login codes and confirm sensitive operations. We do not sell or share your data, and we do not use it for advertising.
POLICY.RETENTION_BODY: Your data is kept for as long as your account exists. When you delete your account, your profile, avatar, friendships, messages and matches are erased immediately and cannot be recovered.
POLICY.RIGHTS_BODY: From the "My data" page you can download a copy of everything we hold about you as a JSON file, and request the deletion of your account. Deletion is confirmed by a link sent to your email address, and both operations are confirmed by email. You can correct your username and email address from your profile.
POLICY.CONTACT_BODY: For any question about your data, write to onitama.transcendance@gmail.com.

TERMS.TITLE: Terms of Service
TERMS.SERVICE_BODY: This site lets you play Onitama online against other players. It is a student project, provided free of charge and without any guarantee of availability.
TERMS.ACCOUNT_BODY: You need an account to play. You are responsible for keeping your password and two-factor codes secret, and for everything done from your account. One person, one account.
TERMS.CONDUCT_BODY: Be respectful in the chat. Harassment, hateful content, cheating, automated play and any attempt to disrupt the service or access other players' data are forbidden.
TERMS.TERMINATION_BODY: You can delete your account at any time from the "My data" page. We may suspend or delete an account that breaks these terms.
TERMS.LIABILITY_BODY: The service is provided as is. We may change or stop it at any time, and we are not liable for lost matches, ratings or data.
